original.target_description: Study 1 hedonic regressions of log listing price in Stockholm, Table 1. Exact regression specification unresolved from supplied locator.

notes: Identity assessment: the ResearchGate wrapper identifies a 2015 SSRN item (10.2139/ssrn.2624181), but the embedded author-uploaded article identifies Eyal Ert, Aliza Fleischer and Nathan Magen, the matching title, Tourism Management 55 (2016) 62–73, and DOI 10.1016/j.tourman.2016.01.013 (canonical L66–L75, L197–L205). This embedded article is primary-report text. The frozen web parse preserves retrieval gaps and is not a complete PDF; assessment is restricted to the available Study 1 results and Table 1. No PDF was supplied. Unassigned sides and fields are placeholders only. Study 1 attractiveness-price relationship appears in multiple Table 1 specifications, and the supplied p.5 locator does not identify one. Candidate coefficients 0.0044, −0.0164 and 0.218 have SEs but no printed p values or attached significance markers. The table legend supplies thresholds for marked results; an absent marker is not treated as a reported p bound. No candidate was selected and no p was computed. Candidate evidence: Host attractive 0.0044 (0.024) 0.0164 (0.025) 0.218 (0.138) ... Standard errors in parentheses.
